_meta.title: I Simulated A T-Rex In Modern New York, It Was Brutal
_meta.style: Rexcaped — prehistoric-predator-in-the-modern-world AI simulation, 2nd-person survival arc
_meta.pipeline: photoreal still (ChatGPT) -> LTX i2v -> ffmpeg render -> grade  [proof clips this session via LTX t2v on MPS]
_meta.worldview_rule: NO dates / NO 'evolution' / NO geologic epochs (young-earth owner). 'ancient world / a world that's gone'. Physical stats OK.
_meta.still_style_suffix: photorealistic, cinematic nature-documentary, modern New York City, overcast winter daylight or sodium-lit night, volumetric haze, film grain, shallow depth of field, IMAX, 16:9, no text, no watermark
_meta.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, six legs, two heads, cartoon, illustration, text, watermark, logo, melting, warping, jpeg artifacts, feathers cartoonish
_meta.notes: 8 hero creature shots = ~20-25% of the finished cut; the rest is stock B-roll, memes, and branded stat cards (see edit_grammar_ruleset.md). i2v_prompt is written full-scene so it doubles as an LTX t2v prompt for this session's proof clips.
